ANYMD_OCR_MAX_TOKENS.description: Optional Doc-VLM token limit per region, from 1 to 8192.

ANYMD_OCR_QUANTIZATION.description: Optional Doc-VLM decoder quantization: none, q8 or q4. Quantization runs on CPU only.

ANYMD_NO_PRO_HINT.description: Set to 1 to disable the optional CLI Pro hint.

NO_PRO_HINT.description: Set to any value, including an empty string, to disable the optional CLI Pro hint.
